messages:
Maya Lopez: Hi all—first day and I'm stuck on kube access. I followed the README to create my kubeconfig but `kubectl get pods -n dev` returns Forbidden. Any quick checks? /cc @DevEx

DevEx: welcome Maya! can you share `kubectl config current-context` and the exact error? also which auth method did you use (SSO/okta)?

Maya Lopez: context: `redwood-dev`; auth: Okta SSO; error: Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "user:maya.lopez@redwood.com" cannot list resource "pods" in the namespace "dev"
I ran `kubectl auth can-i list pods --namespace=dev` -> "no"

Samir Patel: typically new hires are added to the `redwood:team-dev` Okta group during onboarding. please check Okta -> Groups to confirm membership. if it's missing, file the access request form at https://intra.redwood/it/onboard-access and choose Kubernetes -> dev.

Maya Lopez: I don't see the group. I submitted the access form (ticket #6011).

InfraOps: we can put a temporary RoleBinding in place if you need day-1 access. DevEx — here's the minimal RoleBinding we apply for temp access: apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1, kind: RoleBinding, metadata.name: onboarding-maya-temp, namespace: dev, subjects: [{kind: User, name: "user:maya.lopez@redwood.com", apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io}], roleRef: {kind: Role, name: dev-developer, apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io}. infra will revoke after the Okta group sync.

DevEx: note for docs: the quickstart assumes Okta group sync but we should add a troubleshooting bullet for the Forbidden error and show the temp RoleBinding example.

Onboard Bot: access request 6011 status: infra temp-binding applied.

Maya Lopez: confirmed — `kubectl auth can-i list pods --namespace=dev` now returns "yes" and `kubectl get pods -n dev` works. thanks!

Samir Patel: I'll follow up with People Ops to ensure you're added to `redwood:team-dev` so infra can remove the temp binding.

Maya Lopez: great, appreciate it. Small suggestion: include an explicit troubleshooting step in the onboarding doc about Okta group membership + the temp binding snippet.
